mathematical_classes.name: EXACT_STRUCTURAL
mathematical_classes.definition: A deterministic identity, disjointness relation, or mathematically exact subset/bound follows from matched settlement events.

mathematical_classes.name: MODEL_DEPENDENT_STRUCTURAL
mathematical_classes.definition: The contract is a deterministic function of latent election states, but target inversion needs count/joint/dependence assumptions or yields only LP bounds.

mathematical_classes.name: PREDICTIVE_ONLY
mathematical_classes.definition: No logical implication for the SIG target is asserted; the source is eligible only for preregistered empirical prediction tests.

mathematical_classes.name: REJECTED
mathematical_classes.definition: The proposition does not resolve the target 2026 general-election event.

relationships.name: EXACT_EQUIVALENT
assumptions: same contest and election round
same party/candidate event
same tie, recount, runoff, cutoff and resolution-source semantics
forbidden_interpretations: cross-venue arbitrage without lockable offset
equating last trade with probability without calibration
identity from title alone

relationships.name: COMPLEMENT
assumptions: the two claims are exact logical complements on the same settlement domain
forbidden_interpretations: treating Democratic win and Republican win as complements when Other/tie is possible
treating negative-risk metadata alone as proof

relationships.name: EXHAUSTIVE_PARTITION
relationships.equation: For disjoint exhaustive A_k, sum_k P(A_k)=1; P(A)=sum_{k in A} P(A_k).
assumptions: mutually exclusive categories
coverage of every valid settlement state
aligned dates and resolution rules
forbidden_interpretations: summing overlapping thresholds
assuming an omitted Other bucket has zero mass

relationships.name: NONEXHAUSTIVE_PARTITION
relationships.equation: For pairwise disjoint listed A_k, sum_k P(A_k)<=1; residual=1-sum_k P(A_k)>=0.
assumptions: listed outcomes are disjoint
unlisted/Other/tie outcomes remain possible
allowed_interpretations: valid probability upper bounds and explicit residual mass
forbidden_interpretations: renormalizing listed outcomes to one without a stated conditional estimand

relationships.name: THRESHOLD
relationships.equation: P(K>=c)=sum_{k>=c}P(K=k); interval thresholds yield corresponding sums.
assumptions: same count variable and boundary convention
forbidden_interpretations: converting an aggregate threshold into a named constituent probability without bounds/model

relationships.name: COUNT_DISTRIBUTION
relationships.equation: K=sum_r I_r; P(K in B)=sum_x 1{sum_r I_r(x) in B} P(x).
assumptions: same constituent set, party attribution, incumbent/seat universe, and timing
allowed_interpretations: aggregate count probability and exact count-based bounds
forbidden_interpretations: inverting a count distribution into individual race marginals under independence without labeling the assumption

relationships.name: JOINT_OUTCOME
relationships.equation: For a complete A x B table: sum_{a,b}p_ab=1; P(A)=p_11+p_10; P(B)=p_11+p_01.
assumptions: all joint cells are listed, definitions and dates align, and no pooled Other state hides relevant marginals
allowed_interpretations: joint event probability, margins, covariance when complete
forbidden_interpretations: calling a partial table complete or inferring constituent outcomes from a single cell

relationships.name: PARTIAL_JOINT
relationships.equation: max(0,P(A)+P(B)-1)<=P(A cap B)<=min(P(A),P(B)); listed cell J subset A gives P(J)<=P(A).
assumptions: event cell has matching constituents; all residual/Other states remain explicit
allowed_interpretations: Frechet bounds and LP partial identification
forbidden_interpretations: independence or full-table inversion from incomplete joint cells

relationships.name: CONDITIONAL
assumptions: same B event, same conditioning information and settlement time
forbidden_interpretations: using a market phrased “if” as conditional probability without matching B

relationships.name: CONSTITUENT_OF_AGGREGATE
relationships.equation: If A_i is one item in count K=sum I_i, then P(K=N)<=P(A_i)<=P(K>=1) for N constituents.
assumptions: the target is literally included in the aggregate count
forbidden_interpretations: count-to-race point inversion without dependence structure

relationships.name: CHAMBER_CONTROL
relationships.equation: Control may equal 1{party seat count >= majority threshold}, then modified by tie/caucus/leadership settlement rules.
assumptions: exact chamber control definition, VP/tie treatment, caucusing rule and membership date
allowed_interpretations: seat-count bounds with explicit threshold uncertainty
forbidden_interpretations: equating “win chamber” and “control after election” absent matching definitions

relationships.name: MARGIN_DISTRIBUTION
relationships.equation: For disjoint party winner-margin bins M_k, P(party wins)=sum_k P(M_k) only if every positive margin and tie/Other state is covered.
assumptions: margin denominator and top-two rule match
boundary tie-break is followed
bins are disjoint and complete
allowed_interpretations: sum of complete party margin bins; individual-bin lower bounds
forbidden_interpretations: treating within-epsilon closeness as directional winner probability
omitting explicit Other/tie mass

relationships.name: CROSS_RACE_COMPARISON
relationships.equation: I(|M_A|<|M_B|) is a joint comparison; it does not identify P(A wins) or P(B wins).
assumptions: comparison races and winning-round margin are correctly identified
forbidden_interpretations: direct FV for either race winner

relationships.name: PIVOTAL_RACE
relationships.equation: P(|M|<=epsilon) or P(race has minimum |M|) contains no party-direction label.
assumptions: a prior predictive hypothesis is frozen
forbidden_interpretations: party win probability or deterministic bound

relationships.name: SOFT_RELATED
assumptions: any predictive use is preregistered and validated out of sample
forbidden_interpretations: structural edge, exact mapping or arbitrage

relationships.name: TURNOUT_THRESHOLD
relationships.equation: P(T in B) concerns turnout T; winner W is not determined by T.
assumptions: turnout feature has a separately frozen predictive test
forbidden_interpretations: turnout threshold as winner probability

relationships.name: REJECTED_RESOLUTION_SCOPE
relationships.equation: No equation to the 2026 general-election winner is valid.
assumptions: the observed contract resolves candidacy, withdrawal or party-primary pairing
forbidden_interpretations: use as a general-election fair-value input

interpretation_policy.venue_role: Polymarket is an external information/reference venue; SIG is the execution venue.
interpretation_policy.arbitrage: Do not label a discrepancy arbitrage unless offsetting positions can be locked with matched settlement rules.
interpretation_policy.price_inputs: No price, fill, order-book or resolved-outcome field was used in this phase; weights are not fitted.
interpretation_policy.same_race_party_yes_no: D/R win events are disjoint when party categories differ, but they are not complements if Independent/Other/tie is possible.
interpretation_policy.negative_risk: negRisk and groupItemThreshold are metadata only; neither alone proves exhaustive mathematical coverage.
